verdict.rationale: Restate documents a scalable multi-node server cluster (docs-13) and flexible deployment of service 'workers' as containers/serverless/K8s (docs-7), plus concurrency controls (docs-4) and retry/resume on failure (docs-1, docs-15), which together imply some scale-out and fault tolerance. However there is no explicit documentation of how Restate load-balances invocations across a worker fleet or how it detects/tolerates worker loss, and a community comment raises concerns about lack of HA in at least one orchestrator deployment mode (restate-comm-4), muddying the picture. Missing for 10: explicit load-balancing/scheduling algorithm across worker replicas, documented failover behavior when a worker instance dies mid-task, and independent benchmarks/hands-on confirmation of throughput scaling with added workers.
